paper: Fault detection in district heating substations
problem: Identify substation and customer-system faults from automatic meter readings
method: Threshold methods on annual hourly meter series
data: 135 substations, two Swedish DH systems (hourly AMR)
claimed_novelty: Faults found in 74% of substations; three fault groups; AMR enables proactive continuous commissioning
what_they_dont_do: No learned normal-behaviour model, no controller setpoints, no false-alarm budget or lead-time evaluation
how_mine_differs: We score controller-setpoint tracking residuals with a fleet quantile model and evaluate continuous false alarms per substation-year and pre-report recall.

paper: A machine learning approach to fault detection in district heating substations
problem: Predict substation behaviour and separate faulty from well-performing data
method: Several ML models with varied input/output parameters (specific algorithms UNVERIFIED)
claimed_novelty: ML model reproduces substation behaviour with high fault detection capability
what_they_dont_do: Single substation; no cross-substation (fleet) transfer; no alarm-budget or lead-time protocol (per abstract)
how_mine_differs: We train one fleet-shared model on other substations (zero-shot) across 93 substations and two manufacturers with continuous evaluation.

paper: Fault detection and operation optimization in district heating substations based on data mining techniques
problem: Fault detection and operation optimisation in DH substations (title only)
method: UNVERIFIED
claimed_novelty: UNVERIFIED
what_they_dont_do: UNVERIFIED
how_mine_differs: UNVERIFIED (abstract unavailable; ScienceDirect blocked).

paper: Fault and anomaly detection in district heating substations: A survey on methodology and data sets
problem: Review of data-driven fault/anomaly detection in DH substations
method: Literature survey of methods and data sets
claimed_novelty: Field favours unsupervised anomaly detection; lacks labelled public data and industry-relevant benchmark metrics
what_they_dont_do: No new method or experiments
how_mine_differs: We answer its call for industry-relevant metrics with a continuous false-alarm-budget protocol on the public labelled PreDist dataset.

paper: Fault detection for district heating substations: Beyond three-sigma approaches
problem: Gaussian i.i.d. error assumption for fault thresholds fails in the field
method: Quantile regression error model conditioned on time/inputs; ensemble of baseline models over time periods
data: Unlabelled Swedish operator data; labelled residential lab faults
claimed_novelty: Replace Gaussian three-sigma threshold with conditional quantile thresholds
what_they_dont_do: No setpoint-relative residuals, no fleet zero-shot model, no false-alarm-per-year protocol on labelled field faults (per abstract)
how_mine_differs: We also use conditional quantiles, but on setpoint-tracking residuals, fleet-trained on other substations, evaluated on labelled field faults.

paper: Neural network synthetic dataset generation for fault detection in district heating substations
problem: Scarcity of public labelled DH fault data
method: Time-series forecasting, TimeGAN and fault signature transfer to synthesise labelled data
data: ILSE: 547 substations, 1,162 reviewed faults, German DHS
claimed_novelty: Generate shareable synthetic labelled DH data from a large labelled real set
what_they_dont_do: No detector or alarm-budget evaluation; synthetic fault data judged not yet usable
how_mine_differs: We do detection on real public PreDist data, not data synthesis.

paper: From bearings to substations: Transfer Learning for fault detection in district heating
problem: Lack of labelled fault data for DH FDD
method: Transfer learning from bearing vibration data via fault-signature alignment of Delta T
data: Bearing data, lab DH experiments, real operational data
claimed_novelty: Cross-domain TL from bearings; F1 up to 0.98 lab, 0.91 field
what_they_dont_do: Supervised classification; no controller setpoints; no continuous false-alarm budget evaluation
how_mine_differs: We need no fault labels for training; residuals are relative to controller setpoints and scored by a fleet normal model.

paper: HEAT: Hierarchical-constrained Encoder-Assisted Time series clustering for fault detection in district heating substations
problem: Global analysis misses subtle substation anomalies; labels scarce
method: Constrained hierarchical clustering with CAE on supply temperature; intra-cluster MAD z-scores
claimed_novelty: Topology approximation lets neighbours serve as reference; 74.1% sensitivity, 95.5% specificity
what_they_dont_do: Peer comparison at substation level; no setpoint residuals, no time-resolved alarm budget or lead time
how_mine_differs: We use the fleet as a conditional normal model of setpoint tracking, scored every 10 minutes with FA per substation-year.

paper: Federated Multi-Source Data Fusion for Semi-Supervised Fault Detection in District Heating Substations
problem: Scarce labels, privacy and bandwidth limits in DH fault detection
method: Federated one-class VAE with cross-network pre-training and verified-normal fine-tuning
data: 434 substations from two real DH networks
claimed_novelty: First cross-domain data fusion for DH fault detection (claimed); F1 up to 97%
what_they_dont_do: Needs local fine-tuning data; no setpoint residuals; no FA-per-year protocol (per abstract)
how_mine_differs: Our fleet model is zero-shot for the target substation, with only a shrinkage recalibration from its own past.

paper: Enabling predictive maintenance in district heating substations: A labelled dataset and fault detection evaluation framework based on service data
problem: No public labelled DH substation dataset or operational evaluation
method: Autoencoder normal-behaviour models (EnergyFaultDetector), ARCANA attribution; accuracy, eventwise F0.5, earliness
data: PreDist: 93 substations, two manufacturers, faults and normal events
claimed_novelty: Public dataset plus benchmark; 0.98 normal accuracy, F0.5 0.83, 60% faults before customer report
what_they_dont_do: Evaluates on selected event windows; per-abstract no setpoint residuals, fleet zero-shot model, or FA per substation-year
how_mine_differs: Same data; we add setpoint-relative fleet scoring and a continuous every-step protocol with a fixed false-alarm budget.

paper: Towards automation of fault detection and diagnosis for district heating substations: A three-layer hybrid approach
problem: Automating per-substation FDD setup; hard faults
method: ML regression residuals with kNN training-data selection, control-strategy mode rules, boundary thresholds
claimed_novelty: kNN selection of representative training data; detection 104 h before customer report; FA 0.27%/0.01%
what_they_dont_do: Per-substation models; two case studies; whether setpoint residuals are used is UNVERIFIED (full text blocked)
how_mine_differs: We use one fleet model zero-shot on 93 labelled substations with an explicit false-alarm budget; their control-mode rules are the closest DH analogue.

paper: An online fault detection and diagnosis method of sensors in district heating substations based on long short-term memory network and adaptive threshold selection algorithm
problem: Online sensor FDD in DH substations with adaptive thresholds (title only)
method: UNVERIFIED
claimed_novelty: UNVERIFIED
what_they_dont_do: UNVERIFIED
how_mine_differs: UNVERIFIED (abstract unavailable); adaptive thresholds may overlap our calibration step - check full text.

paper: From lab to practice: Towards a substation-invariant self-supervised transformer for low-label fault detection in district heating
problem: Low-label, heterogeneous DH fault detection
method: Self-supervised time-series transformer with regularised fine-tuning on primary-side data
data: Six datasets: lab emulations, simulation, real DH networks
claimed_novelty: Primary-side temperatures carry fault information; transfer works within a network, asymmetric across networks
what_they_dont_do: Needs fine-tuning labels; no secondary-side setpoints; no FA-per-year budget (per abstract)
how_mine_differs: We use secondary-side controller setpoints and a label-free fleet model, tested across two manufacturers.

paper: Fouling fault detection and diagnosis in district heating substations: Validation of a hybrid CNN-based PCA model with uncertainty quantification on virtual replica synthesis and real data
problem: Detect heat-exchanger fouling in DH substations
method: CNN plus PCA with uncertainty quantification; UA as input
data: Virtual replica synthetic data and real data
claimed_novelty: UQ for fouling detection; accuracy 96.6-98.2%
what_they_dont_do: Single fault type; supervised accuracy; no alarm-budget protocol
how_mine_differs: We target all labelled fault types via control-loop shortfall with false-alarm-calibrated thresholds.

paper: From data scarcity to diagnostic precision: A novel data augmentation and fault diagnosis framework for district heating substations
problem: Fault diagnosis under scarce labels
method: CNN-LSTM with attention, FAST pattern-mixing augmentation, transfer learning
claimed_novelty: FAST augmentation; F1 about 0.95 lab, 0.92 real
what_they_dont_do: Supervised diagnosis; no unsupervised fleet monitoring or FA budget
how_mine_differs: We do label-free detection, not supervised diagnosis.

paper: Creating a labeled district heating data set: From anomaly detection towards fault detection
problem: How to build labelled DH fault datasets
method: CRISP-DM-based guidelines; minimum viable feature set
claimed_novelty: Domain-specific dataset-creation process and minimal feature set
what_they_dont_do: No detector, no evaluation
how_mine_differs: We use an existing labelled dataset and contribute method plus evaluation protocol.

paper: Automatic fouling detection in district heating substations: Methodology and tests
problem: Detect heat-exchanger fouling automatically
method: Meter-data methodology (primary flow, both-side temperatures) in software
data: 325 heat exchangers, six Turin DH networks
claimed_novelty: Automatic fouling detection for large networks with data gaps
what_they_dont_do: Single fault type; abstract notes set-points vary conditions but no setpoint-residual model
how_mine_differs: We model setpoint tracking explicitly and evaluate multiple fault types under an alarm budget.

paper: Fault Detection and Condition Monitoring in District Heating Using Smart Meter Data
problem: Use smart-meter data for PHM in DH
method: Clustering of load cycles plus per-cluster energy-outdoor temperature regression; KPIs
claimed_novelty: Learns substation control behaviour; expert-verified findings
what_they_dont_do: No quantitative labelled evaluation; per-substation regression
how_mine_differs: We use labelled faults, a fleet model, and FA-budget metrics.

paper: Is it returning too hot? Time series segmentation and feature clustering of end-user substation faults in district heating systems
problem: Ground-truth collection and fault symptom patterns
method: Self-organising maps with k-means; time-series decomposition anomaly algorithm
data: Danish utility; 50 detailed cases of 127 fault reports
claimed_novelty: Return temperature reliably indicates faults, energy use does not
what_they_dont_do: No controller setpoints; no false-alarm budget evaluation
how_mine_differs: We use secondary-side setpoint residuals rather than return temperature alone.

paper: A systematic approach for data generation for intelligent fault detection and diagnosis in District Heating
problem: Labelled DH fault data scarcity
method: Lab substation emulation with climate chamber; isolation forest, OC-SVM, RF, SVM
data: Lab: six scenarios incl. valve leak, stuck valve, high heat curve
claimed_novelty: Controlled fault signatures; 1-5 min sampling improves FDD
what_they_dont_do: Lab data only; no field fleet
how_mine_differs: We work on field data from 93 substations.

paper: Automated Statistical Methods for Fault Detection in District Heating Customer Installations
problem: Find installations with poor cooling performance
method: Statistical algorithm on meter readings
claimed_novelty: Automatic detection; 1273 poor-cooling installations flagged
what_they_dont_do: Screening, not time-resolved alarms; no labels
how_mine_differs: We issue time-resolved alarms validated against reported faults.

paper: Ranking Abnormal Substations by Power Signature Dispersion
problem: Thresholds for power-signature outliers cause misses or false alarms
method: Robust regression; outliers plus R2 dispersion merged by Borda count
claimed_novelty: Rank substations by dispersion and outliers; beats outlier-only ranking
what_they_dont_do: Ranking not alarms; no setpoints
how_mine_differs: We calibrate thresholds to a false-alarm budget instead of ranking.

paper: CARE to Compare: A Real-World Benchmark Dataset for Early Fault Detection in Wind Turbine Data
problem: No detailed public wind-turbine fault benchmark
method: Dataset plus CARE score (coverage, accuracy, reliability, earliness)
data: 36 turbines, 3 farms, 44 anomaly and 51 normal time frames
claimed_novelty: Most detailed public WT fault dataset (claimed); CARE score
what_they_dont_do: Wind not DH; event-window scoring
how_mine_differs: We propose continuous FA-per-asset-year evaluation for DH instead of event-window scoring.

paper: Fleet-Wide Condition Monitoring via Shared Nominal Representations and Local Radius Calibration
problem: Per-asset detector and threshold engineering scales with fleet size
method: One shared autoencoder per asset family; per-asset residual-quantile radius from short nominal stream
claimed_novelty: Representation transfers but error scale does not; local radius calibration suffices
what_they_dont_do: Bearings only; no control loops; no Bayesian shrinkage
how_mine_differs: Same fleet-model/local-calibration spirit; we add setpoint residuals, empirical-Bayes shrinkage and DH field validation.

paper: Anomaly Detection in Wind Turbines: Persistence-Based Alarm Confirmation for False-Alarm Mitigation and Detection-Latency Trade-Offs
problem: Decision rule shapes false alarms and latency
method: Persistence-based confirmation over IF, OC-SVM, PCA, autoencoder
data: OpenFAST simulations; one industrial SCADA bearing fault
claimed_novelty: Persistence should be an explicit decision variable
what_they_dont_do: Wind; no guaranteed FA budget
how_mine_differs: We set thresholds by an explicit per-substation FA budget, plus a daily decision unit.

paper: Chronologically calibrated PCA for wind-turbine SCADA health monitoring: a leakage-controlled CARE v6 benchmark
problem: Detectors must limit false alarms without hiding missed events
method: PCA reconstruction with chronological conformal threshold; identity-disjoint split
claimed_novelty: Leakage-controlled locked test; conformal PCA beats fixed isolation forest
what_they_dont_do: Wind; per-case models; conformal gave same alerts as empirical calibration
how_mine_differs: Closest protocol analogue; we apply FA-budget calibration with fleet zero-shot setpoint residuals in DH.

paper: Drift-Aware System Assurance for Wind-Turbine SCADA Condition Monitoring
problem: Turn anomaly scores into auditable alarms under drift
method: PCA scoring, rolling-quantile persistent alarms, phase-space regime summaries
claimed_novelty: Alarm burden reporting; alarm policy needs site-specific recalibration
what_they_dont_do: Wind; two faults; no fleet model
how_mine_differs: We study recalibration via fleet-to-local shrinkage across 93 assets.

paper: CALM-5G: Event-Level Conformal Risk Control for Predictive Service-Assurance Alarms
problem: Converting forecasts into alarms with guarantees
method: Conformal risk control on violation events; out-of-sample calibration choice
claimed_novelty: Certified miss rate and duty cycle; online calibration under label shift
what_they_dont_do: Telecom, not physical assets
how_mine_differs: Different domain; we bring FA-budget conformal thresholds to DH fleet monitoring.

paper: Foundations of population-based SHM, Part III: Heterogeneous populations - Mapping and transfer
problem: Transfer health knowledge across a population of structures
method: Domain adaptation; topology-based mapping
claimed_novelty: Theory for population-based SHM transfer
what_they_dont_do: Structures, not control loops; no alarm budgets
how_mine_differs: We apply population (fleet) modelling to DH control loops without feature mapping.

paper: Automatic Process Monitoring in a District Heating Substation Utilizing a Contextual Shewhart Chart
problem: Process variable normal range shifts with external factors
method: Contextual Shewhart chart with contextual variable (e.g., outdoor temperature)
claimed_novelty: Context-dependent control limits
what_they_dont_do: Single substation; no fleet model; no labelled evaluation (per abstract)
how_mine_differs: We condition limits via a fleet quantile model, on setpoint residuals, over 93 labelled substations.

paper: Severe Fault Diagnosis in Digitized District Heating Network Substations: A Machine Learning Regression Approach
problem: FDD without labels
method: Multiple regression models plus knowledge-based diagnosis
claimed_novelty: Two-stage regression plus rules
what_they_dont_do: Case study; no FA budget evaluation (per abstract)
how_mine_differs: We evaluate fleet-wide on labelled public data.

paper: Learning-based Fault Detection and Diagnosis in District Heating Substations
problem: Real-world constraints on DH FDD
method: Eight studies: locality anomaly detection, augmentation, transfer, federated, streaming fleet representations
claimed_novelty: Scalable deployable DH FDD incl. continuous fleet-scale monitoring
what_they_dont_do: Setpoint residuals and FA-budget thresholds not mentioned
how_mine_differs: Its 'continuous fleet-scale monitoring' strand is close; we differ by setpoint-residual target and guaranteed FA budget.

paper: Automated and real-time anomaly indexing for district heating maintenance decision support system
problem: Too many detected faults to investigate
method: Chernoff bound to rank fault probability within maintenance framework
claimed_novelty: Chernoff bound filters insignificant faults
what_they_dont_do: No calibrated false-alarm budget; one case
how_mine_differs: We control false alarms per substation-year directly via calibrated thresholds.

paper: Data-Driven Fault Detection and Diagnosis in District Heating Substations and the Impact of Return Temperature Reduction
venue: Lecture Notes in Networks and Systems
problem: Find substation inefficiencies raising return temperature
method: Python tool: KPIs, geospatial mapping, scatterplot segmentation
claimed_novelty: Four recurring fault patterns; prioritisation tool
what_they_dont_do: No time-resolved detector
how_mine_differs: We provide time-resolved alarms from secondary-side setpoints.

paper: Temporal Conformal Prediction for Wind Turbine Anomaly Detection: A Robust Distribution-Free Framework with Conditional Clustering
problem: Heteroskedastic errors, no finite-sample coverage in WT monitoring
method: Cluster turbines; per-cluster healthy-data regression; sequential conformal 85%/99% intervals
claimed_novelty: Distribution-free alerts; 87.2% recall, 72-day lead
what_they_dont_do: Wind; FA per asset-year not reported (per abstract); no shrinkage
how_mine_differs: Fleet-cluster plus conformal already exists in wind; ours adds setpoint residuals, zero-shot cross-fitting and DH validation.

paper: RBC-AD: conformal anomaly detection with explicit false-alarm control for the Tennessee Eastman Process
problem: Score drift and transients inflate false alarms
method: TCN forecaster, fused nonconformity, conformal thresholds, k-consecutive alarms
claimed_novelty: Explicit normal-alarm-rate target with conformal decisioning
what_they_dont_do: Simulated single process; no fleet
how_mine_differs: We apply FA-budget conformal thresholds per asset in a real fleet.

paper: Trustworthy Anomaly Detection for Industrial Control Systems via Conformal Deep Autoencoder
problem: False alarms in ICS anomaly detection
method: CNN-LSTM autoencoder with post-hoc conformal thresholds and temporal quantile adjustment
claimed_novelty: Guaranteed false alarm rates via conformal
what_they_dont_do: ICS security; no fleet
how_mine_differs: Conformal FA guarantees are known; our novelty is not the conformal step itself.

paper: Adaptive Conformal Anomaly Detection with Time Series Foundation Models for Signal Monitoring
problem: FA control under shift without training
method: Weighted quantile conformal on foundation-model forecasts
claimed_novelty: Score interpretable as FA rate (p-value); adaptive weighting
what_they_dont_do: Generic; no fleet or control loops
how_mine_differs: Alternative calibration for our thresholds; we use fleet prior plus local shrinkage.

paper: Fleet-Wide Data-Driven Model Generation Process for Residual-Based Fault Detection in Wind Energy
problem: NBMs are single-turbine/manufacturer, hard to deploy fleet-wide
method: Automatic simple models valid for all turbines; multi-turbine residual indicators
data: Several farms and manufacturers; four faults
claimed_novelty: Fleet-valid residual models tested on unseen farms
what_they_dont_do: Wind; ROC only; no FA budget; no setpoints
how_mine_differs: Fleet residual models exist in wind; we target setpoint residuals in DH with FA-budget protocol.

paper: Transfer learning applications for autoencoder-based anomaly detection in wind turbines
problem: Training per-turbine AEs is costly
method: Cross-turbine transfer; fine-tune AE, decoder or threshold only
claimed_novelty: Threshold-only adaptation can match per-turbine baseline; multi-turbine training no gain
what_they_dont_do: Wind; constant thresholds
how_mine_differs: Supports our fleet-model-plus-local-calibration design; we test it in DH.

paper: Quantile regression neural network-based fault detection scheme for wind turbines with application to monitoring a bearing
problem: Normal-behaviour modelling for fault detection
method: QRNN quantiles plus EWMA chart on residuals
claimed_novelty: QRNN beats MLR/BPNN; control-limit width vs alarm count
what_they_dont_do: Single turbine; no fleet
how_mine_differs: We use fleet conditional quantiles (LightGBM) across assets.

paper: Challenges in detection of heating curve misconfiguration: An empirical study
problem: Detect substations needing heating-curve update
method: Prophet return-temperature trends; conditional autoencoder NBM
data: DH substations with customer reports (dataset UNVERIFIED; cites PreDist)
claimed_novelty: Both methods largely fail for heating-curve faults; substation-specific models overfit
what_they_dont_do: No setpoint-residual target, no fleet model
how_mine_differs: Directly motivates our fleet model; we measure shortfall against controller setpoints.

paper: A Physically Informed Changepoint Score for Fault Prioritisation in District Heating
problem: Poor-cooling faults have unknown onset
method: BEAST changepoints weighted by probability, size, deviation and physical direction
claimed_novelty: Prioritisation and onset dating; AP 0.772
what_they_dont_do: Retrospective ranking; no streaming alarms or setpoints
how_mine_differs: We give online alarms with FA budget rather than retrospective ranking.

paper: Identifying untraced faults associated with high return temperatures from heating systems in buildings connected to district heating networks
problem: Untraced building heating faults raising return temperature
method: Analysis of heat cost allocators and energy meters
claimed_novelty: Identifies controller failures, HX overflow, bypass faults
what_they_dont_do: No automatic detector
how_mine_differs: We automatically detect controller-tracking failures.

paper: Comparative investigation of seven supervised regression reference models for chiller fault detection: generalization to unseen days and detection at a matched false alarm rate
problem: Reference models compared on training day without tests
method: Seven regression reference models; leave-one-day-out; detection at matched FA rate
claimed_novelty: Reference model determines threshold transfer to new days
what_they_dont_do: Chiller lab; no fleet
how_mine_differs: We evaluate at a fixed FA budget across a fleet.

paper: From Fleet-Wide Screening to Turbine-Level Diagnosis: A SCADA-Based Two-Step Machine Learning Approach for Generator Electrical Faults in Wind Turbines
problem: Generator electrical faults hard to diagnose from SCADA
method: Fleet OC-SVM screening then per-turbine SVR residual change points
claimed_novelty: Detection months before failure
what_they_dont_do: Wind; one case
how_mine_differs: We use fleet modelling as the residual model itself, not just screening.

paper: Statistical Modelling of Individual Substations in a District Heating System
problem: Models of substations that transfer to others
method: SARIMAX on heat power and Delta T
claimed_novelty: Delta-T model transfers to other substations
what_they_dont_do: Simulated faults; no setpoints
how_mine_differs: Early transfer evidence; we test fleet transfer on labelled faults.
